caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different amount of weights
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during fine-tuning of a Whisper model with varying amounts of weights. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, marked at regular intervals of 1. The y-axis represents the WER, with a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, marked at intervals of 10. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different configuration: tiny AdaLoRA_int4 (solid line with circles, gray) starts at approximately 68 and decreases to around 35; tiny AdaLoRA_int8 (dashed line with squares, dark gray) starts at around 62 and decreases to approximately 35; tiny int4 (dashed line with circles, light gray) starts at about 60 and decreases to around 38; tiny int8 (dashed line with squares, light gray) starts at approximately 58 and decreases to around 38; and tiny full (dotted line with triangles, dark gray) remains steady, starting and ending at around 28.
